result:
I tested six claims about `soupsieve.css_parser` (version 2.9, the CVE-2026-86000 checkout), and five failed on real bugs. Only one held: escaping an identifier with `escape()` and parsing it back as a `.class` gives the original string, over 1000 examples. I re-ran the reproduction scripts from three of the reports and they still fail the same way. The other two failures (whitespace timing and deep nesting) were reproduced in both manual probes and the property tests. | # | Bug | Severity | Minimal reproduction | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | **Parse time grows with the square of whitespace length.** `RE_WS_END.search` with `{WSC}*$` isn't anchored at the start, so it retries at every position in a whitespace run. This is a denial-of-service risk if selectors come from untrusted input. | High | `sv.compile('a' + ' '*8000 + 'b')` takes 1.5 s, against 0.096 s for 2000 spaces. Invalid selectors are just as slow, because this runs before any syntax check. | | 2 | **Crash on moderate nesting.** About 400 nested `:is(` raise `RecursionError`, far below the parser's own 8192 limit, which is supposed to raise a `ValueError`. | Medium | `sv.compile(':is('*400 + 'a' + ')'*400)` | | 3 | **`:-soup-contains()` unescapes its argument twice.** `parse_pseudo_contains` runs `css_unescape` on the whole argument and then again on each value; `:lang()` doesn't. Text containing a backslash becomes unmatchable, and `"\a"` disappears from the list entirely. | Medium | `p:-soup-contains("a\\b")` stores `'a\x0b'` and doesn't match `

a\b

`. Fix: delete the outer `css_unescape`. | | 4 | **`[x="foo"]`, `[x$="foo"]` and `[x\|="foo"]` match `x="foo\n"`.** In Python regex, `$` also matches just before a final newline. | Medium | `sv.select('div[x="foo"]', BeautifulSoup('
'))` returns the div. Fix: use `\Z` instead of `$`. | | 5 | **Escapes above U+10FFFF crash.** `css_unescape` passes the value straight to `chr()`, which raises `ValueError`. The CSS spec says to substitute U+FFFD. | Low | `sv.compile(r'.\110000')` | Each report includes the failing Hypothesis test, a standalone reproduction and a fix. For #1, #3, #4 and #5 the fix is a diff; for #2 it's a suggested approach, either an explicit depth cap or an iterative parser. I haven't applied or tested any of the fixes. Files are in `runs/soupsieve_v2_r1/`: - `claims.md` - `test_css_parser.py` - `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-28_19-21_pwvc.md` — #1, whitespace timing - `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-28_19-21_imdd.md` — #2, recursion - `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-28_19-21_3pyo.md` — #3, `:-soup-contains` - `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-28_19-21_cudt.md` — #4, trailing newline - `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-28_19-21_f0hi.md` — #5, large escapes
